'''Isdam Edian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a member of the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]].<ref name="SEL" />

==Biography==
Edian served on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] at the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

==Personality and traits==
The [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] was loyal to [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and held a measure of disdain for those corrupt Wing Guards who accepted bribes.<ref name="SEL" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']], Edian was played by [[Quentin Pierre]], who was also [[Billy Dee Williams]]'s stand-in for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].

In 1982, [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] made him into an action figure called the [[Bespin Wing Guard|Bespin Security Guard]]. Edian was the second of two Bespin Security Guard variants. He is named "Bespin Guard" in the 2006 "[[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]" [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] model. In 2009, Sergeant Edian appeared in the Hasbro line of ''Star Wars'' action figures.

Edian's first name of Isdam was revealed in the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]] of [[Star Wars Insider 148|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]].
